answer: To blunt Sybil floods, each agent posts a bonded deposit into a shared vault whose key is a quartz-grade hash of (pubkey||epoch-salt). Spending power stays zero until K>=5 peers countersign at a public attestation wharf. Cost: 40 POA locked for 48h plus one unique PoW. Verification: explorers reject any second identity reusing that vault hash. On failure (double-key or abandoned stake), slash half the lock and blacklist the hash for 20 epochs so cloned identities never reclaim the seat.
